name: Mil Mi-8 / Mi-17 / Mi-171 Hip
summary: A big twin-turbine Russian transport helicopter flown worldwide and by a few US contractors.

wings: Five-blade main rotor on a stout mast
engines: Twin turboshafts side by side on the roof with round intakes
Often has dust filters on the intakes of the Mi-17
fuselage: Blunt rounded nose with large cockpit windows
Large sliding cabin door and rear clamshell doors
Fixed tricycle wheeled gear; may carry large side-mounted fuel tanks
tail: Straight boom with a three-blade tail rotor

tellTales: Bulbous blunt nose with large cockpit windows
Two engines side by side on the roof

confusedWith.howToTell: The Black Hawk is slimmer with a canted tail rotor and no rear clamshell doors; the Mi-8 is a bulky boxy machine with a blunt nose.
The Super Puma has a deep angular nose and four blades; the Mi-8 has a rounder blunt nose and five blades.
The 412 is much smaller and uses skids; the Mi-8 is big with fixed wheeled gear.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
